经过: 秦二世废卫君角为庶人，卫绝祀。
text_en: The Second Emperor of Qin reduces Jue, lord of Wey, to a commoner, and the sacrifices of Wey come to an end.

经过: 陈胜败走下城父，为御者庄贾所杀，张楚亡；余部归项梁所立楚怀王。
text_en: Chen Sheng is defeated and flees to Xiachengfu and is killed by his charioteer Zhuang Jia; Zhang Chu falls, and its remnants join King Huai of Chu, set up by Xiang Liang.

经过: 章邯破魏于临济，魏王咎自焚（同年魏豹复立魏）。
text_en: Zhang Han crushes Wei at Linji, and Jiu, king of Wei, burns himself to death (Wei Bao restores Wei later the same year).

经过: 子婴素车白马降于轵道旁，秦亡（教科书多作前207）。
text_en: Ziying surrenders beside Zhidao in a plain carriage drawn by white horses, and Qin falls (usually dated 207 BC).

经过: 匈奴冒顿单于袭破东胡，东胡王死，余众分保乌桓山、鲜卑山。
text_en: Modu Chanyu of the Xiongnu falls on the Donghu and kills their king; the survivors withdraw to the Wuhuan and Xianbei mountains.

经过: 田荣击杀胶东王田市。
text_en: Tian Rong kills Tian Shi, king of Jiaodong.

经过: 田荣击杀济北王田安，并王三齐。
text_en: Tian Rong kills Tian An, king of Jibei, and makes himself king of all three Qi realms.

经过: 汉王还定三秦，塞王司马欣降。
text_en: The king of Han returns to conquer the Three Qins; Sima Xin, king of Sai, surrenders.

经过: 翟王董翳降汉。
text_en: Dong Yi, king of Di, surrenders to Han.

经过: 燕王臧荼击杀辽东王韩广，并其地。
text_en: Zang Tu, king of Yan, kills Han Guang, king of Liaodong, and takes his land.

经过: 河南王申阳降汉，置河南郡。
text_en: Shen Yang, king of Henan, surrenders to Han, and Henan Commandery is set up.

经过: 陈余借齐兵袭常山，常山王张耳败走归汉；陈余迎赵歇复王赵。
text_en: Chen Yu attacks Changshan with troops from Qi; Zhang Er, king of Changshan, flees to Han, and Chen Yu restores Zhao Xie as king of Zhao.

经过: 汉王渡河，下河内，虏殷王司马卬，置河内郡。
text_en: The king of Han crosses the Yellow River, takes Henei and captures Sima Ang, king of Yin; Henei Commandery is set up.

经过: 汉引水灌废丘，雍王章邯自杀。
text_en: Han floods Feiqiu, and Zhang Han, king of Yong, kills himself.

经过: 韩信破魏，虏魏王豹，置河东、太原、上党郡。
text_en: Han Xin defeats Wei and captures Bao, king of Wei; Hedong, Taiyuan and Shangdang Commanderies are set up.

经过: 韩信、张耳破代兵，擒代相夏说于阏与。
text_en: Han Xin and Zhang Er defeat the army of Dai and capture its chancellor Xia Yue at Yuyu.

经过: 井陉之战，韩信斩陈余于泜水上，擒赵王歇（一说追杀于襄国）。
text_en: At the battle of Jingxing Han Xin beheads Chen Yu on the Zhi River and captures Xie, king of Zhao (another account says Xie was pursued and killed at Xiangguo).

经过: 九江王英布叛楚，楚使项声、龙且击破九江，英布奔汉。
text_en: Ying Bu, king of Jiujiang, breaks with Chu; Chu sends Xiang Sheng and Long Ju to crush Jiujiang, and Ying Bu flees to Han.

经过: 潍水之战，韩信斩龙且，虏齐王田广。
text_en: At the battle of the Wei River Han Xin kills Long Ju and captures Tian Guang, king of Qi.

经过: 垓下之战，项羽自刎乌江，西楚亡。
text_en: After the battle of Gaixia Xiang Yu cuts his own throat by the Wu River, and Western Chu falls.

经过: 临江王共尉不降，卢绾、刘贾击虏之。
text_en: Gong Wei, king of Linjiang, refuses to submit; Lu Wan and Liu Jia attack and capture him.

经过: 韩王信降匈奴，国除。
title_en: King Xin of Han (韓) defects to the Xiongnu
text_en: Xin, king of Han (韓), goes over to the Xiongnu, and his kingdom is abolished.

经过: 英布反，击杀荆王刘贾。
text_en: Ying Bu rebels and kills Liu Jia, king of Jing.

经过: 南越王赵佗攻灭安阳王，并瓯雒（年代有前208、前179 诸说）。
text_en: Zhao Tuo, king of Nanyue, overthrows King An Dương and annexes Âu Lạc (the date is variously given as 208 or 179 BC).

经过: 七国之乱，吴王刘濞兵败被杀，国除。
text_en: In the Rebellion of the Seven States Liu Bi, king of Wu, is defeated and killed, and his kingdom is abolished.

经过: 闽越围东瓯，汉发兵救；东瓯举国内徙江淮之间。
text_en: Minyue besieges Dong'ou and Han sends troops to its rescue; the whole state of Dong'ou then moves inland to the lands between the Yangzi and the Huai.

经过: 大月氏南下，臣服大夏；张骞前128 至其地时已属月氏。
text_en: The Greater Yuezhi move south and subject Daxia (Bactria); when Zhang Qian arrives in 128 BC it already belongs to the Yuezhi.

经过: 燕王刘定国有罪自杀，国除。
text_en: Liu Dingguo, king of Yan, kills himself after his crimes come to light, and his kingdom is abolished.

经过: 卫青收河南地，逐楼烦、白羊王。
title_en: Loufan and Baiyang kings driven out
text_en: Wei Qing recovers the land south of the Yellow River and drives out the kings of Loufan and Baiyang.

经过: 淮南王刘安谋反事觉，自杀，国除为九江郡。
text_en: The plot of Liu An, king of Huainan, is discovered; he kills himself and his kingdom becomes Jiujiang Commandery.

经过: 衡山王刘赐谋反，自杀，国除。
text_en: Liu Ci, king of Hengshan, plots rebellion and kills himself, and his kingdom is abolished.

经过: 浑邪王杀休屠王，率众降汉。
title_en: The Hunye king surrenders to Han
text_en: The Hunye king kills the Xiutu king and surrenders to Han with his people.

经过: 休屠王欲降而悔，为浑邪王所杀。
text_en: The Xiutu king plans to surrender but changes his mind and is killed by the Hunye king.

经过: 江都王刘建谋反，自杀，国除。
text_en: Liu Jian, king of Jiangdu, plots rebellion and kills himself, and his kingdom is abolished.

经过: 济东王刘彭离有罪，废徙上庸，国除。
text_en: Liu Pengli, king of Jidong, is deposed for his crimes and banished to Shangyong, and his kingdom is abolished.

经过: 路博德、杨仆破番禺，南越亡，置九郡。
text_en: Lu Bode and Yang Pu take Panyu; Nanyue falls and nine commanderies are set up.

经过: 汉平南夷，置牂柯郡；夜郎侯入朝，受封夜郎王。
text_en: Han subdues the southern Yi and sets up Zangke Commandery; the lord of Yelang comes to court and is made king of Yelang.

经过: 汉诛邛君，以邛都为越巂郡。
text_en: Han executes the lord of Qiong and makes Qiongdu into Yuexi Commandery.

经过: 东越王余善反，汉军入闽，越繇王居股杀余善降；徙其民江淮间。
text_en: Yushan, king of Dong Yue, rebels; Han armies enter Min, Jugu, the Yao king of Yue, kills Yushan and surrenders, and the people are moved to the lands between the Yangzi and the Huai.

经过: 汉兵临滇，滇王举国降，置益州郡，赐滇王王印。
text_en: Han troops reach Dian and the king submits with his whole realm; Yizhou Commandery is set up and the king of Dian receives a royal seal.

经过: 杨仆、荀彘攻王险城，朝鲜相杀右渠来降，置乐浪等四郡。
text_en: Yang Pu and Xun Zhi besiege Wanggeom; the ministers of Joseon kill King Ugeo and surrender, and Lelang and three other commanderies are set up.

经过: 燕王刘旦谋反，自杀，国除。
text_en: Liu Dan, king of Yan, plots rebellion and kills himself, and his kingdom is abolished.

经过: 王莽代汉，建国号新，西汉亡（25 年光武复汉）。
text_en: Wang Mang takes the throne from Han and names his dynasty Xin; the Western Han ends (Emperor Guangwu restores Han in AD 25).

经过: 绿林军入长安，王莽死于渐台，新亡。
text_en: The Lülin armies enter Chang'an and Wang Mang is killed on the Jian Terrace; Xin falls.

经过: 赤眉入长安，更始帝刘玄降，旋被杀。
text_en: The Red Eyebrows enter Chang'an; the Gengshi Emperor Liu Xuan surrenders and is soon killed.

经过: 赤眉为冯异所破，刘盆子率众降于宜阳。
text_en: Feng Yi defeats the Red Eyebrows, and Liu Penzi surrenders with his followers at Yiyang.

经过: 刘永为部将所杀（27），子刘纡继立，29 年败亡。
text_en: Liu Yong is killed by his own officers (AD 27); his son Liu Yu carries on until he is defeated and killed in 29.

经过: 耿弇破张步于临淄，张步肉袒降。
text_en: Geng Yan defeats Zhang Bu at Linzi, and Zhang Bu surrenders, stripped to the waist.

经过: 彭宠为家奴所杀，渔阳平。
text_en: Peng Chong is killed by his own slaves, and Yuyang is pacified.

经过: 朱祐围黎丘，秦丰出降，被斩。
text_en: Zhu You besieges Liqiu; Qin Feng comes out to surrender and is executed.

经过: 窦融遣使归汉，以河西五郡奉光武。
text_en: Dou Rong sends envoys to submit to Han, placing the five commanderies of Hexi under Emperor Guangwu.

经过: 董宪败于朐，被杀。
text_en: Dong Xian is defeated at Qu and killed.

经过: 马成拔舒城，李宪败死。
text_en: Ma Cheng storms the city of Shu (舒) and Li Xian dies in defeat.

经过: 隗嚣病饿而死（33），子隗纯继立，34 年降汉。
text_en: Wei Xiao dies of illness and hunger (AD 33); his son Wei Chun succeeds him and surrenders to Han in 34.

经过: 吴汉破成都，公孙述伤重死，成家亡。
text_en: Wu Han takes Chengdu; Gongsun Shu dies of his wounds and Chengjia falls.

经过: 卢芳降汉受封代王后复叛，42 年逃入匈奴。
title_en: Lu Fang flees to the Xiongnu
text_en: Lu Fang submits to Han and is made king of Dai, rebels again and in AD 42 flees to the Xiongnu.

经过: 高句丽太祖王伐东沃沮，取其地（据《三国史记》）。
text_en: King Taejo of Goguryeo attacks Eastern Okjeo and takes its land (according to the Samguk sagi).

经过: 哀牢王柳貌率众内属，置永昌郡。
text_en: Liumao, king of Ailao, submits with his people, and Yongchang Commandery is set up.
